title: Porosity and fractal study of functionalized carbon nanofibers: Effects of the functionalization degree on hydrogen storage capacity
material_description: UFCNFs | unfunctionalized carbon nanofibers, SBA-15 hard-templated (sucrose, pyrolysed 1273 K, HF-etched)
purification_method: HF 10 wt% aqueous to remove SBA-15 silica template
functional_groups: -COOH IR band at 1724 cm-1 absent (meager functionalization); bands at 1211 and 1583 cm-1 present
source_location: Sec. 3.4 text, main text p.76 (refers to Fig. 11)
notes: Text: 'at relative low pressures the higher uptake (about 1.4 wt%)'; pressure given only in words, so unstated. Probably the highest plotted point of Fig. 11 (digitized 1.01415 atm, 1.42105 wt%) but the paper does not say so, so kept as a separate row without isotherm_id. wt% convention not stated. Table 1: S_BET 810 m2/g (N2, BET from desorption isotherm; text sec. 3.3.1 gives 775 to 476 m2/g for the series, inconsistent with Table 1 and Table 3), total pore volume V_P(NLDFT) 664 mm3/g, micropore volume V_Mi 144 mm3/g (method not stated; NLDFT stored as primary method), intrawall volume V_iw(NLDFT) 120 mm3/g (no field), D_P(NLDFT) 3.5/4.9 nm (several modes; average_pore_diameter left empty). Temperature printed as 76 K (N2 bath, boiling point at Mexico City), stored as 76.0 K. Degassing: preparation port heated to 573 K for 300 min, then analysis port 573 K for 21 h (21 h stored; heating rate printed as 283 K/min); no end pressure stated. Instrument Micromeritics ASAP 2020; the paper does not name the method (volumetric/gravimetric) or the basis and describes no free-volume calibration, so method unknown and basis unknown. Pressure axis printed in atm (absolute), converted x1.01325. H2 purity 99.998%.
